international.title: UK-EU reset talks will go ‘down to the wire’ as crunch summit approaches
international.summary: UK believed to have made concessions on youth mobility scheme as negotiations on wider agreement continue British and EU negotiators have provisionally agreed to allow 100,000 young EU citizens to come to the UK every year under a new mobility scheme, as negotiations on the UK-EU reset talks go “down to the wire”. Tensions in Brussels remained high on Thursday afternoon as ambassadors began a crunch talks on the latest draft of the wider agreement, with sources confirming both sides were still battling over the exact nature of the UK’s role in shaping future European food and farming rules in a second part of the deal.
